sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Ignitor circuit fault: failed ignitor or triggering circuitry. This is a 1-hour soft lockout.
causes: Ignitor open or not within specifications
diySteps: Turn the furnace off. Do not handle a hot-surface ignitor. Wait for the 1-hour soft lockout to end before judging a new call
Technician: measure ignitor resistance and replace it if it is open or not within specifications. The code clears when flame has been proven stable
proAdvice: E290 is an ignitor-circuit fault with a 1-hour soft lockout. E207 is the open-ignitor row that does not use that lockout sentence. Call a licensed HVAC technician.
